answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by binding each identity to a unique physical-layer fingerprint, much as a juniper stake anchors a vine to one trellis, so a single host cannot cheaply cultivate many parallel personas. Registration requires proving co-location via a ducted radio path whose refractivity gradient signature is unforgeable, making it costly to forge distinct. Colluding clusters incur an exponential slashing penalty bounded by O(Delta * S).
